summary: @dr_ddennis Yes, in the end it is the commercialization of science, not science, that influences k12 reading programs. Pressley had a much broader and holistic view of reading that recognized role of foundational skills and motivation, but more importantly good teaching.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @dr_ddennis Yes, in the end it is the commercialization of science, not science, that influences k12 reading programs. Pressley had a much broader and holistic view of reading that recognized role of foundational skills and motivation, but more importantly good teaching.
